newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers gain, rest of Europe dips.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers gain, rest of Europe dips.

text.p: Rotterdam fuel oil bunkers firmed slightly on Thursday with signs of some improvement of bunker demand, while fuel oil elsewhere mostly softened, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil bunkers were sold at around $84.50/$85 fob, as barge prices headed up to $83 ex wharf.

Suppliers differed as to today's total ARA bunker demand. One player put it as high as 30,000 tonnes. Others said it was under 20,000 tonnes. Most, however, agreed that the market had improved from Wednesday, but that most of the business had gone to majors.
The Hamburg market lagged Rotterdam, dipping by about $1 a tonne in response to weakness in ARA on Wednesday.
Mediterranean bunkers were on average $2 lower for fuel oil, but steady for gas oil.
Saudi fuel oil prices were 50 cents higher in the Gulf at $212 and $1.50 higher in the Red Sea at $198.50 effective from Thursday.
